name: Anuradhapura
tagline: The first great capital of Sri Lanka, with giant white stupas, a sacred fig tree grown from the Buddha's tree and 1,300 years of royal ruins.
highlight: Watching pilgrims in white circle the Ruwanwelisaya stupa at dawn with flowers and lamps.
shortDescription: A UNESCO-listed ancient capital, active as a pilgrimage centre, with the Sri Maha Bodhi tree, the Ruwanwelisaya and Jetavanaramaya stupas, monasteries, ponds and palace ruins.
metaDescription: An Anuradhapura travel guide: Sri Maha Bodhi, Ruwanwelisaya stupa, Jetavanaramaya, Abhayagiri, Isurumuniya, the ancient ponds, how to see it by bike, where to stay, tickets and a one-day plan.
nearestAirport: Colombo Bandaranaike (CMB), about 4.5–5 hours by road
knownFor: Ancient stupas, the Bodhi tree, pilgrimage
budget: US$50–100 per day, mid-range, plus ticket

image.alt: The white dome of the Ruwanwelisaya stupa in Anuradhapura

intro: Anuradhapura was the capital of the first Sinhalese kingdom from the 4th century BCE, and for more than a thousand years a centre of Theravada Buddhism and of civilisation in the island. At its height, it was one of the largest cities in South Asia, with monasteries housing thousands of monks, giant reservoirs and palaces. Abandoned in the 11th century, it was rediscovered in the 19th, and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Unlike many ruins, Anuradhapura is still a place of living worship. The Sri Maha Bodhi, a sacred fig tree grown from a cutting of the tree under which the Buddha attained enlightenment, is said to be the oldest historically documented tree in the world, planted in 288 BCE. Pilgrims in white bring flowers and lamps, and the giant white stupas, huge domed shrines, still dominate the skyline. The Ruwanwelisaya, from the 2nd century BCE, is the most revered.

The site is spread over several square kilometres, so bicycles or tuk-tuks are the best way to see it. Other highlights include the massive Jetavanaramaya, once the tallest brick structure in the world, the Abhayagiri monastery, the Twin Ponds and Isurumuniya Rock Temple. A day and a half is a good visit, combined with Sigiriya and Polonnaruwa.

whyVisit.intro: Anuradhapura is Sri Lanka's oldest capital, and a place where ancient history is still practised.
